recommendedTitle: Give the completion RPC one best-effort owner
summary: Five call sites invoke try_complete_campaign_if_drained and only two guard it. campaign-queue-completion.server.ts:51-68 and ivr/status.action.server.ts:130-153 catch and log; the #2048 campaign-settle-recheck.server.ts catches and logs under a third event name; campaign.server.ts continueOrCompleteDispatch and auto-dial.server.ts:437-444 do not catch at all, so an RPC failure propagates and fails the dispatch job or dial drain. An RPC failure only means 'not complete yet', which must never fail unrelated work.
currentBehavior: Completion failures are reported three different ways depending on surface, and on two surfaces they fail the surrounding job instead of being absorbed.
rootCause: Each call site invented its own try/catch and log message. The #2048 wrapper was created for the same reason, so there are now two wrappers and three policies.
resolution: One internal helper owns 'ask the gate, log, never throw', with a comment stating why. All five call sites use it and lose their own try/catch. Collapse campaign-settle-recheck.server.ts into the same owner rather than keeping two wrappers. Normalise the log event name and fields so a completion failure reads the same from every surface.

summary: The call-in verification number is now platform data instead of an environment variable: a verification_number table holds the numbers, getActiveVerificationNumber reads the one active row, the Admin System Settings panel registers, activates and removes a number, and the session route answers 503 'Call-in verification is not configured' when no row is active.
currentBehavior: The code is in master. What is left is a person's action on master, so the issue stays open until they finish it and confirm it.
resolution: No new code. Register and activate the number (or run the operator script), then make the real call and confirm it.
existingTests: No automated test for this change. scripts/configure-verification-number.mjs registers and activates a number in one transaction and is the operator path, and docs/release-test-guide-2026-10-19.md:13-21 lists the manual checks.
acceptanceCriteria: A person confirms the reported symptom is gone on master.
rootCause: PARTIAL, and manual. What is covered: the number is no longer an invisible, redeploy-only environment variable. It is a database row, it is visible and changeable in Admin, the decision is written in docs/adr/0038, and the route answers a clean 503 instead of failing. What is not covered: the number itself. The issue's screenshot is the Call settings modal showing 'Call-in verification is not configured', and that is exactly what production still shows after this release, because no row is active. The release guide for the same release says so in plain words. The remaining work is an operator action, not a code change: register and activate a number in Admin (or run scripts/configure-verification-number.mjs), then place a real verification call. manual: true because that last step is a real phone call to a real handset. The candidate commit 6c7c361a (PR #2726) is not an ancestor of origin/master by SHA, but its content is in master through the release merge 91c4409b.
